reason: I'm watching every dollar, and I'd want to see a sample or a track record before paying. Wukong is new, unaudited, invite-only and paid in USDC on Solana, which my org's finance person would never sign off on. For a small task I'd just ask ChatGPT for a draft or send it to the freelancer I already trust.
objection: Nothing proves it works yet. There's no track record and no audit. I'd have to fund in crypto and sit through a contest where most entries get nothing, when a freelancer or ChatGPT gets me a draft for far less hassle.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real finished tasks with sample winning entries and their scores, and being able to pay by card or invoice instead of USDC. The free trial task would also have to be genuinely free and not need a crypto wallet.
